Ordinary acceptance checks the server deadline after acquiring the existing booking lock; recurring occurrences remain exempt, and decline/refund behavior is unchanged.
Request cards use the server deadline and flags, hide an unsupported zero-visit-fee earnings estimate, and link to booking details.
Next-job actions are family-aware; accepted time-based sessions and proposal OTP/delivery actions open booking details, and proposal confirmed/delivery_pending work is active.
Mutation success requires a refreshed same-booking-id status readback. No appearance flag or money-safety gate was added.
